advisoryNote: advisory.<lane>: a floor the owner has DECIDED to hold ABOVE the headless pass-count (see decided[]). The floor itself is untouched and the bridge lanes still enforce it. visual-truth:check reports such a lane as a named WARNING instead of an error, because a required CI lane that is red by standing decision is permanently red and hides every other regression behind it. An advisory entry is NOT a waiver: the check still FAILS if the headless count drops below headlessPassesMeasured (a real regression), if floorHeldAt no longer equals floors.<lane> (the floor moved without revisiting this entry), or the moment the lane meets its floor headlessly (the entry is then stale and must be removed, so enforcement resumes by itself). Add an entry only with the same sign-off a floor change needs; record the measurement that backs it.
